ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) background with a low frequency of high-intensity (white) localized pixels; estimated white-to-black pixel ratio of approximately 0.12:1 across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white circular focal spots scattered globally across both fluke lobes; dense concentration of high-intensity pixel clusters at the distal tips; numerous unaligned linear white streaks predominantly visible on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate interior angle of 58 degrees; notch depth corresponds to roughly 14% of the visible vertical fluke plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the trailing edge; pixel amplitude of valleys increases towards the distal tips, creating a jagged profile isolated from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curvature transitioning from the central notch to mid-lobe, with a distinct upward sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular high-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with barnacle scarring across the entire visible surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct, multi-directional linear pixel disruptions (rake marks); high concentration of long, diagonal parallel lines on the left lobe and shorter, intersecting linear marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, irregular structural protrusions consisting of high-intensity pixel masses (epibiotic growth) concentrated along the peripheral edges of both distal tips; widespread permanent depigmentation from rake marks across the mid-sections of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced accumulation of raised, high-contrast pixel clusters specifically localized at the extreme lateral vertices of the fluke lobes.
